Corollary

1. ch5:5.6Every compact embedded submanifold is properly embedded.

Proof

For every compact $K\subseteq M$, the Hausdorff property makes $K$ closed. Thus $K\cap S$ is closed in the compact space $S$, hence compact, so the inclusion $S\hookrightarrow M$ is proper.

□
